notes.title: 🔥 Millennium Artifacts Bundle – Our First AgeofGames Bundle!
notes.content:
Calling all adventurers, tacticians, and RPG enthusiasts! We're excited to announce the launch of the Millennium Artifacts Bundle, featuring a collection of our top titles at 53% off. Whether you're into action-packed RPGs or strategic tower defense, this bundle has something for you! 💥

Here's what you'll get:

King Island: Dive into an immersive and humorous action RPG. Explore the island, battle enemies, complete quests, and uncover hidden treasures in a world filled with comedy and chaos. Fight crazy cows and level up your hero in this classic ARPG experience!

King Towers: A retro tower defense game where strategy is key! Defend your kingdom from relentless waves of villagers, knights, evil witches, and even cows with dangerous weapons. Keep your gold and mana safe in this fast-paced, challenging game.

Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars: Lead your armies in epic, turn-based tactical warfare. Immerse yourself in a European fantasy world as you navigate four campaigns filled with heroes, quests, and powerful enemies.

Etrom 20th Anniversary Edition: A point & click action RPG set in a dark future. Explore sprawling cities, engage in epic battles, and navigate parallel dimensions in this enhanced version of the original 2003 game.

Chroma Wars: Engage in high-skill strategic battles in this techno-fantasy warfare. Command powerful armies and fight to save your base from abyssal foes in a retro turn-based strategy format.

Eukarion Tales 2: Embark on a dangerous adventure against the forces of Kaos in this classic Flash RPG. Complete quests, gain experience, and equip powerful weapons and armor to face your foes.

Whether you're reliving these Flash classics or playing them for the first time, now's the perfect time to dive in!

Get the Millennium Artifacts Bundle now for 53% off and start your adventure today! ⚔️✨

notes.title: Fantasy Kommander Eukarion Wars is now LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars is now available on Steam! 

Developed by us and released for the first time in 2013, now in collaboration with Troglobytes Games and Untold Games, Fantasy Kommander is back!

Our turn-based strategy game invites you to command armies, unravel captivating storylines, and relive a classic experience with pre-rendered 90s-style graphics.

Special Launch Price: $4.99 (38% off from $7.99) - Limited Time Offer!

[b]Immerse Yourself in Epic Battles:[/b]

Embark on a medieval-inspired isometric fantasy journey, mastering the intricacies of the Archangelus tactical simulation system on hexagonal maps.

[b]Discover Mysterious Enemies:[/b]

Follow the guidance of Emperor Karl and the Grand Council of Mages as you uncover a mysterious enemy plotting in the shadows. Lead Heroes – Humans, Elves, and Dwarves – to triumph across the Empire of Adamantia and uncharted lands.

[b]Conquer Realms, Be Forever Victorious:[/b]

Engage in multiple battles, each offering gold, fame points, and various benefits for successful completion. With a complex battle system, immersive narrative, and over 70 unique units, Fantasy Kommander promises an unparalleled gaming experience.

Don't miss out on this epic adventure! Grab your copy now on Steam and lead your armies to victory!

notes.title: Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars RELEASES NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517042/f38dd65df2a6f764394962d87cdc9a9a431445f0.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, 

Are you ready to embark on a strategic, turn-based fantasy journey with us? 
 
We are pleases to announce that in collaboration with Troglobytes Games and Untold Games, we will be releasing Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars on the 18th of January 2024 for the price of $7.99 (with a fantastic discount, meaning you can grab the game on launch day for just $4.99!

Raptor will be streaming the game on his YouTube channel, and later on our store page, so keep an eye out for that too!
 
[b]Immerse Yourself in Epic Battles: Unravel the Story Across Four Campaigns[/b] 

Fantasy Kommander invites players to immerse themselves in a medieval-inspired isometric realm of fantasy, featuring 90s-style pre-rendered graphics for a nostalgic experience that’s set to catapult fans of the genre back to one of the true classics of our time. Command armies, master the intricacies of the battle system, and unravel a captivating storyline across four campaigns filled with heroes, quests, and formidable enemies.
 
Battles unfold on hexagonal maps, regulated by the proprietary tactical simulation system "Archangelus." Deploy a diverse array of units, from hundreds of soldiers to unique characters such as war machines, mighty archers, priests, cavalry and dragons. Each unit, akin to classic RPG characters, possesses distinct characteristics and abilities that can be enhanced through the hard earned experience gained on the battlefield.
  
[b]Discover Mysterious Enemies: Conquer Realms, Be Forever Victorious[/b]
 
As a valiant general amidst a devastating war, players will receive messages from Emperor Karl and the Grand Council of Mages, guiding them to discover a mysterious enemy plotting in the shadows. Three mighty Heroes stand alongside players, representing Humans, Elves, and Dwarves, ready to assist in trials, challenges, and triumphs across the great Empire of Adamantia and mysterious uncharted lands. Each campaign comprises multiple battles with escalating objectives, offering gold, fame points, and various benefits for successful completion. With a complex battle system, immersive narrative, and over 70 unique units, Fantasy Kommander promises a rich gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517042/852c9533d1d567b84a268b59bc73960d85595ae1.jpg[/img]
 
The game will be available on Steam for PC on January 18th for the price of $4.99, we hope to see you wishlisting the title, and jump on with us next week!
